title: ICJ-Graph: A Citation Graph and a Layered Document Corpus of the International Court of Justice
abstract: arXiv:2611.02630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present ICJ-Graph, a machine-readable resource connecting documents of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to cited cases, legal provisions and United Nations resolutions. Court decisions, written pleadings and oral records form distinct document layers, preserving the distinction between the Court's reasoning and the parties' submissions. The collection contains 6,396 ICJ documents and 505 documents from other courts and legal bodies, together with 12,375 provisions and 20,291 UN resolutions. The data files contain text, metadata and embeddings. The accompanying pipeline lets users load the graph and generate embeddings for use in their own retrieval systems. To illustrate the resource's use, we evaluate five models on citation prediction for 199 decisions using documents available before each decision. Tools designed for citation research improve citation-prediction F1 over answering without tools for all five models across cas

translated_title: ICJ-Graph：国际法院的引文图谱与分层文档语料库
translated_abstract: 我们提出了ICJ-Graph，这是一个机器可读的资源，将国际法院（ICJ）的文件与其引用的案例、法律条款和联合国决议相互连接。法院判决、书面诉状和口头记录构成不同的文档层，保留了法院推理与当事方陈述之间的区别。该数据集包含6,396份国际法院文件和505份来自其他法院及法律机构的文件，以及12,375条法律条款和20,291项联合国决议。数据文件包含文本、元数据和嵌入向量。随附的处理流程允许用户加载图谱并生成嵌入向量，以便用于自己的检索系统。为了展示该资源的用途，我们使用每项判决作出之前可获取的文件，对五个模型在199项判决的引文预测任务上进行了评估。结果表明，专为引文研究设计的工具相比无工具回答，提升了所有五个模型的引文预测F1分数。
tldr: 本文构建了ICJ-Graph，一个将国际法院文件与其引用的案例、法律条款和联合国决议相连接的机器可读引文图谱与分层文档语料库，并通过引文预测任务验证了其在法律信息检索中的应用价值。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ICJ-Graph, a machine-readable citation graph and layered document corpus connecting ICJ documents to cited cases, legal provisions, and UN resolutions, demonstrating its value for legal information retrieval through citation prediction tasks.
